entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return something.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and the order number, please?

Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling up your account now... I see the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 24th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
There's no issue. I just changed my mind. It was an impulse buy for a New Year's resolution that's not happening.
I see. So you're finding that you just don't use it as much as you thought you would?
I don't use it at all. Figured I had to call and see if anything could be done before I tried some resale marketplace. So, what's the verdict?
Of course. Let me just check the policy for that item. One moment... Okay, I've got it pulled up here. It looks like you're well within the 90-day return window for the Cadence Sensor.
Oh. Really? I was sure you were going to tell me it was too late. Fine.

Not at all! I see you're one of our VIP customers, Mark, and we're happy to take care of this. I've just initiated the return. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. You should see it in your inbox within the next few minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it at any post office.
Well, that was easier than I expected. Whatever. So a full refund?
Yes, once we receive the item back at our warehouse, a full refund will be issued to your original method of payment. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
